description: Continuously mirrors data from an external database (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Snowflake, PostgreSQL) into Fabric. Provides near real-time replication without ETL pipelines. Mirrored data is queryable via SQL endpoint.

definition_parts.description: Mirroring configuration with source database connection and table mappings

notes: Create uses type-specific endpoint POST /mirroredDatabases (not generic /items)
Start/stop mirroring: POST .../startMirroring and .../stopMirroring with empty body {}
Status endpoints use GET (not POST): GET .../getMirroringStatus

OPEN mirroring (push-based, no source connection): fabio mirrored-database create --open-mirroring [--default-schema dbo] configures the mirroring.json source type 'GenericMirror' (target 'MountedRelationalDatabase', format Delta). An empty create leaves the item MirroringDefinitionMissing. A fresh item is briefly MirroredDatabaseNotReady, so the definition push is retried.

OPEN mirroring landing zone: fabio mirrored-database landing-zone prints the OneLake URL (onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<ws>/<id>/Files/LandingZone). Push a numbered <n>.parquet (20-digit zero-padded) per table under Files/LandingZone/<Table>/ plus a _metadata.json ({keyColumns:[...]}) in that folder (upload via: fabio lakehouse upload --id <mirroredDbId> ...), then: fabio mirrored-database start
